faq.title: Questions (& answers)
faq.postit: You didn't forget to buy coffee, did you?

questions.question: What does the subscription cost?
questions.answer: We always tailor our subscriptions based on needs and design complexity — typically, our clients pay between 80,000 - 160,000 SEK per month.

questions.question: How quickly will I get my designs?
questions.answer: On average, you'll receive your designs within 48 hours or less. More complex projects, like larger websites or apps, may take longer. In such cases, we break down the request into smaller parts and deliver them step by step.

questions.question: How many requests can I make?
questions.answer: As many as you want! We handle them one by one based on priority and deliver within 48 hours.

questions.question: How do you handle larger projects?
questions.answer: We manage larger projects by dividing them into smaller, more manageable parts. Each part is then handled one by one and delivered within 48 hours.

questions.question: How does pausing the subscription work?
questions.answer: When you pause your subscription, you save your remaining days for that month, which you can use anytime in the future. For example, if you have 10 days left in a month and pause your subscription, you can use those 10 days at any time in the future at no additional cost.

questions.question: What happens if I only have one design request?
questions.answer: If you only have one design request, such as a website, you can pause your subscription once it's completed. This way, your remaining days won't go to waste, and you can use them again when you have a new design request.

questions.question: What happens if I'm not satisfied with a design?
questions.answer: No problem! We will continue revising until you are 100% satisfied.

qura.tagline: Helping Qura raise $2.1M through lightning-fast design iteration.
qura.quote: Every design that Kindred delivers is completely magical!
qura.author: Arvid Winterfeldt

paragraph.text: Qura is revolutionizing legal research with AI, allowing lawyers to search hundreds of databases in seconds from a single natural-language prompt. To secure funding and adoption, they needed an intuitive and seamless user experience. Our team at Kindred collaborated with Qura to refine their product design, ensuring that legal professionals could navigate vast legal databases effortlessly. Through a human-centered approach, we simplified complex workflows and created a clear, accessible interface that elevates user confidence and efficiency.

lineText.title: From complexity to simplicity
lineText.text: Legal research requires precision, clarity, and trust. We designed an interface that prioritizes structured results, making it easy for legal professionals to find and validate sources without unnecessary friction.

lineText.title: A design built for funding and growth
lineText.text: Our work with Qura helped them present a polished, investor-ready product, supporting their successful €2.1M funding round led by Cherry Ventures.

mycomine.tagline: MycoMine gets a complete facelift with a new brand and website.
mycomine.quote: I got goosebumps when I saw the new website. We are grateful to have worked with Kindred, and hope to do so again in the future.
mycomine.author: Magnus Ivarsson

paragraph.text: MycoMine is pioneering bioremediation with cutting-edge fungal technology, and they needed a compelling brand and digital presence to match their innovation. We worked with MycoMine to refine their brand identity and design a website that effectively communicates their mission, impact, and scalability — in order to attract funding and position themselves as a leader in sustainable waste management.

lineText.title: A brand built for trust and innovation
lineText.text: To resonate with investors and industry stakeholders, we developed a visual identity that balances scientific credibility with an approachable, modern aesthetic.

lineText.title: A website designed to drive funding
lineText.text: We crafted a structured, compelling web experience that highlights MycoMine’s technology, success stories, and measurable impact—ensuring clarity for investors and partners.
